issue.title: test_matches_filter_order_and_tab_completion fails under full parallel lane
issue.description: During mirrored_bead_status_sync verification on 2026-08-12, just check escalated to the full non-visual suite and failed tests/ace/tui/modals/test_snippet_name_modal.py::test_matches_filter_order_and_tab_completion plus the already-tracked logs-pane flake. The current diff touches external issue mirroring, CLI/help/docs, and mirror tests, not snippet modal behavior. The exact snippet-modal node passed immediately in isolation with .venv/bin/pytest tests/ace/tui/modals/test_snippet_name_modal.py::test_matches_filter_order_and_tab_completion -vv. Scope: root-cause the full-parallel/pass-isolation failure by mechanism or decide whether this node belongs in the reproducible-flake baseline with this bead named.

payload.entry: RELATED: sase-ct — retired umbrella for ACE TUI full-parallel/pass-isolation flakes; its close policy routes new nodes like this into narrow tasks rather than reopening the umbrella.

RELATED: sase-jb — same just check full-lane run also reproduced tests/ace/tui/test_logs_pane.py::test_logs_tab_g_and_shift_g_scroll_detail_extremes, already tracked there; a shared ACE/TUI parallel-lane mechanism may bear on both.
